pages.text: Open the Jar menu with $(k:key.headinajar.jar_menu) while you are the jar. A Life Support Jar has three slots; a Reinforced Jar has five. A $(item)Compact Jar$() also has three and is head-sized: your head faces the front and the whole jar turns with it (a jar alone in a crafting grid becomes the other kind). Powered modules stop when the charge runs out.
